findings.title: Do not require Cv completion when the reduced Jacobian has no columns
findings.details: The new !refinement && !gasFinite(cv) branch executes before the j<rank feedback loop. With independentRank==0 there is no Cv or E consumer and no Jacobian entry to produce, yet absent coefficient backing returns TemperatureFailure/InvalidModel with evaluated=false. With fully backed but overflowing linear Cp data it returns TemperatureFailure/NonFiniteInput. Both cases returned Success at the inherited HEAD; irreversible rates and their AD derivatives are finite. This introduces a caloric failure dependency for an unused channel, contrary to the zero-count skip and consumed-property requirement.
findings.requested_change: Scope the newly added terminal Cv recovery/diagnostic to an actual nonempty fixed-U feedback consumer. Preserve positive-rank formulas/order and true missing consumed caloric data handling. Add zero-rank missing-backing and unused-overflow regression coverage; do not introduce a refusal, validator, persistent array, or generic fallback change.
findings.coverage_gap: The frozen zero_rank_storage case supplies finite complete caloric data, so it checks null basis/output storage but not the unused Cv channel.
